(Lodged In Dist Jail Sirohi)
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Ramesh Dewasi S/o Shri Peera Ram, R/o Rewariwas  Kojra, Ps Pindwara, Dist Sirohi, Raj.
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Shambhoo Singh Rathore  Mr. Hitendra Singh
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shrawan Singh Rathore, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 12/11/2024

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.33/2024 registered at Police Station Pindwara,
Dist. Sirohi, for the offences under Sections 342, 363, 366, 376, 376(2)
(n) of IPC and Sections 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the statements of the victim 'J' recorded before the competent criminal Court on 18.05.2024 as PW-02, learned counsel submitted that as per the victim 'J', on 23.01.2024, she was taken by the present petitioner in a rented room in the dharamshala.
As per the prosecutrix, the petitioner and the co-accused Dhiraj @ Dhirendra Kumar subjected her to forcible sexual assault/rape in the aforesaid rented room.

[2024:RJ-JD:45532] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-4611/2024] Drawing attention of the Court towards various documents attached with the challan papers by the Investigating Agency, learned counsel submitted that the victim 'J' was in constant touch with the petitioner through mobile phone.
However on relations between them turning strained, she has falsely roped the petitioner in a criminal case.

It Suresh Kumar vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:45532) on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46764246/
1 was submitted that the co-accused Dhiraj @ Dhirendra Kumar (S.B. CRMLB No.7584/2024) has already been enlarged on bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 14.06.2024.

sentences.text: Lastly, learned counsel submitted that the case of the present petitioner is not worse than that of case of the above named co-accused person; the petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.

Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that looking to the seriousness of the accusations levelled against the present petitioner, he does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.
However, he was not in a position to refute the fact that the above named co-accused person has already been enlarged on bail by the Co- ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 14.06.2024.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that the petitioner who is aged about 20 years is in judicial custody; the co-accused Dhiraj @
Dhirendra Kumar against whom identical [2024:RJ-JD:45532] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-4611/2024]
allegations have been levelled by the victim 'J' (PW-02) in her Court statements has already been enlarged on bail by the Co- ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 14.06.2024; the statements of the victim 'J' have already been recorded before the competent criminal Court and now there is no apprehension of the petitioner influencing the victim 'J' or fleeing away from justice or tampering with the evidence, in case he is enlarged on bail.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Suresh Kumar S/o Shri Uda Ram, arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.33/2024 registered at Police Station Pindwara, Dist. Sirohi, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 9-divya/-
